name: 01-game-paoyong-clean-cover
prompt:
Edit the FIRST reference image, an industrial-design three-view board of the blue “泡涌” game case. Preserve the overall board composition, three aligned exterior views FRONT / SIDE / BACK, clear blue jewel-case architecture, ocean blue/cream palette, artwork identity and clean warm-white catalog presentation. This is an updated visual concept for approval, NOT a live website update.
IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the oversized circular mechanical spindle and plastic clamp currently punch through the character's face on the front. REMOVE that entire front-visible hub, clamp, spindle and hole. The CLOSED FRONT must instead show one completely uninterrupted printed paper cover underneath clear flat polymer, using the complete cheerful blue jellyfish ICON from reference TWO. Both eyes and mouth must be intact and clearly visible. NO center hole, NO center circle, NO circular plastic ornament, NO disk-shaped hole through the character, NO round white dot on the face. This is physically plausible: the actual optical disc and its normal holder are INSIDE the case BEHIND the opaque front paper artwork and are not visible when the case is closed. The case front is a graphic cover, not a disc label.
The SIDE retains the slim blue transparent hinged case profile. The BACK retains the promotional illustration from reference THREE and small “泡涌 / WORK-04 / GAME DISC” catalog text.
Keep large Chinese exterior labels “正面”, “侧面”, “背面”. Heading “游戏光盘 / 泡涌 · 封面修订”. Bottom statement “完整封面 · 光盘内藏 · 不遮挡角色”.
In the bottom margin, include one small clearly secondary open-case diagram labeled “开盒示意”: a hinged lid with intact cover paper, an interior silver optical disc with a standard center holder, no character face printed under the holder. The closed front is the dominant object and must contain NO hub at all. Do not enlarge or stylize the holder anywhere. No red markup, no annotations from the user's screenshot. High quality coherent PBR design presentation, accurate materials, restrained labels, no extra invented logos or features.

name: 02-photo-array-compatible
prompt:
Create a clear polished industrial-design and WEBSITE-CONTEXT concept sheet explaining how a redesigned photographic archive object fits into the existing dense 3D archive array. This is a proposal image, not an actual implemented website or an engineering certificate. Wide landscape, very high resolution, warm off-white background, crisp labels, PBR real-time-friendly geometry.

Reference ONE is the EXISTING WEBSITE and its array geometry. Preserve its camera perspective, dense aligned file rows, floating dark capsule navigation and quiet paper-white visual world. Reference TWO is the actual panoramic Yangshuo photograph to insert. Reference THREE is the previous panoramic frame concept; use ONLY its slate-blue metal, dusty-rose edge and ivory paper materials, DO NOT preserve its extra-wide outer shape.

CRITICAL GEOMETRIC FIX:
The whole NEW photograph archive object's OUTER ENVELOPE is a conventional compact archival folio/frame approximately 5.0 units wide x 3.7 high x 0.35 thick, roughly a 1.35:1 rectangle, the SAME outer envelope as the existing array cassette. Existing spacing is 5.2 across columns and 0.62 front-to-back. Its outer frame MUST NOT be a 2.6:1 panoramic strip and must NOT occupy multiple array columns. The PHOTOGRAPH INSIDE the frame alone retains its native 2.6:1 panorama aspect ratio, fully visible without cropping or stretching. Achieve this with generous top and bottom ivory archival-card mount inside the uniform rectangular outer body. No folding or bending of the photograph, no expanding outer frame, no magical morphing. A tiny PHOTO-01 paper tab stays within the outer silhouette. Simple clean thin metal rectangle; no disc, no reels, no hub, no circuit board. Blue-gray anodized outer border #49576C, a very subtle dusty-rose inner bevel #B18889, warm ivory mount.

LAYOUT:
Top section, approximately 55 percent of board height, is a wide CONTEXT RENDER adapted from reference ONE. In the real array show ONE selected new PHOTO-01 folio raised from its slot with the same footprint as the old object; neighboring files remain neatly spaced with no overlap. Show the actual panorama centered on its front within ivory top/bottom mat. Preserve the existing website context and navigation with only minimal correct labels “摄影作品”, “PHOTO-01”, “阳朔 / 2026.08.27”. Put a small honest caption “阵列适配概念预览”.
Bottom section is THREE aligned EXTERIOR VIEWS of the SAME compact folio: front rectangle (panoramic photo centered within ivory mat), true thin side profile, and matte slate-blue rear rectangle with four tiny retaining clips and an ivory archive card “PHOTO-01 / 阳朔 / 2026.08.27”. Front and back are equal-sized 1.35:1 bodies, never panoramic outer frames.
Heading “摄影档案 / 阵列适配修订”.
Exterior view captions “正面”, “侧面”, “背面”.
Small footer “外框统一尺寸 · 照片保留原比例 · 抽取后点开大图”.
Do not depict a 2.6:1 giant frame in the grid, do not squash the photo to fill the outer body, no new interaction panels or colorful buttons. The difference between OUTER SLOT ENVELOPE and INNER PHOTO ASPECT RATIO must be immediately visible. Keep the board legible and practical rather than a decorative poster.
